class.name: SteamAuth
class.brief_description: Issues Steam tickets for a trusted backend.
class.description: Use [method SteamClient.auth] after boot. Local observation expires after 15 seconds. The client cancels Web API handles at scope shutdown. The native encrypted ticket reservation stays active until Steam delivers its result.

method.name: web_ticket
method.description: Await a [SteamWebTicketResult] for the named service. Use a nonempty audience of at most 255 UTF-8 bytes without ASCII control characters. The backend must verify the same audience and AppID.

method.name: ownership_ticket
method.description: Await a [SteamOwnershipTicketResult] containing an encrypted app ticket for the backend's 1-to-1024-byte challenge. Steam allows one pending request across client scopes and enforces its own rate limit.
